messages:
customer_jordan: Hey team — customer ran into errors when they tried to use the rerank endpoint with a streaming client. They set `stream=true` and included `Accept: text/event-stream` and `Content-Type: text/event-stream`. Server returned a mix of 415 and 400 and some suspicious scores (0 and NaN). Any clarity on whether rerank supports SSE or whether this is client misuse?

maria_support: quick answer: rerank is synchronous only. Streaming (SSE) is supported for generate/chat endpoints, but not for rerank. We should collect the exact request/response snippets and give a clear repro + fix to the customer.

devon_api: please paste raw headers/body and the response status+body. 415 points to incorrect Content-Type. If they used `text:event-stream` as Content-Type that's wrong (should be `application/json`). 400 could be our validation rejecting the stream param or Accept header.

customer_jordan: pasted from customer logs: 
```
POST /v1/rerank
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer sk-live-XXX
  Accept: text/event-stream
  Content-Type: text/event-stream
Body: {"query":"how to compress images","candidates":["jpeg","webp","png"]}
Response: 415 Unsupported Media Type
Body: {"error":"unsupported media type: text/event-stream"}
```
They then retried with `Content-Type: application/json` but kept `Accept: text/event-stream` and added `stream=true` and got: 400 with `{ "error": "streaming not supported for rerank" }`. The returned scores from one run looked like: `[0, 0, NaN, 0]`.

maria_support: so two issues: wrong Content-Type and misuse of streaming headers/params. The NaN/zero scores likely come from the request failing mid-parse and our pipeline returning a partial/invalid result in some codepath. Need SRE/dev to confirm.

annika_sre: I'll query the ingress logs for request ids/timestamps. If the client used chunked/event-stream encoding our parser might abort and the scoring pipeline could return a partial object. Please ask the customer for a request-id or exact timestamp + source IP.

ingress-bot: [AUTO] 1769012347 - 415 - unsupported media type - route: /v1/rerank - ua: python-requests/2.28 - req_id=rid_e4b2 - src_ip=34.82.101.12

devon_api: Proposed repro steps for support to hand back (safe):
1) Bad (415 due to wrong content-type):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"query":"q","candidates":["a","b"]}'
```
2) Bad (400 due to streaming usage):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -d '{"query":"q","candidates":["a","b"], "stream": true}'
```
3) Good:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"q","candidates":["a","b"]}'
```
Note: `stream` param is unsupported for rerank. Also `Accept: text/event-stream` and `Content-Type` must not be set to SSE.

maria_support: let's also remind customers to check API key features/quotas — customer earlier got a 403 with `feature_not_enabled` when using a key that only had embeddings rights. So include that as a checklist: key permissions, headers, candidate limits.

devon_api: Action items for engineering:
- Change validation to return clear error when Accept includes `text/event-stream` or when `stream` param is present (prefer 422 with an explicit message).
- Ensure Content-Type validation returns 415 with actionable guidance telling them to use application/json.
- Prevent returning partial results on parse/validation failures (no results array in error responses).
I've opened ticket RED-API-1873 and will own the change.

annika_sre: I found one entry for req_id=rid_e4b2 where the client sent chunked body with SSE headers and our body parser raised a parse error mid-stream. Pipeline had a race and frontend serialized a partial scores array (containing uninitialized floats leading to NaN). I'll push a hotfix to ensure parse errors abort with a single error response and no results payload. Canarying now.

ingress-bot: [AUTO] 1769012458 - 400 - streaming header present - route: /v1/rerank - req_id=rid_e4b2 - action: ticket RED-API-1873 created

maria_support: Suggested short reply to the customer to close loop: 
"Thanks for the repro. Rerank is a synchronous endpoint and does not support SSE streaming. Please ensure: 1) Use `Content-Type: application/json` (not `text/event-stream`), 2) Remove `Accept: text/event-stream` and do not set `stream=true`, 3) Confirm your API key has rerank enabled/quotas. Example working curl: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"query":"best way to compress images","candidates":["jpeg","webp"]}'
```
If you still see unexpected scores after that, please reply with the full request/response and any request-id. We're rolling a fix so parse errors won't return partial results and we'll improve the error message to be more actionable.
"

customer_jordan: ok sending that. thanks all :thumbsup:

maria_support: follow-ups: add a short note in the rerank docs that streaming is unsupported and add a unit/integration test rejecting Accept headers containing `text/event-stream` or similar SSE patterns.

devon_api: will include tests in the PR for RED-API-1873.

annika_sre: Hotfix patch staged to staging, will monitor canary for errors before rolling to prod.

maria_support: closing once prod fix is live. Keep me posted on cadence.
